## What and why

## Type of change

- [ ] Site (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, text)
- [ ] Pipeline or data (Python, dbt, schemas, rights rules)
- [ ] Workflow or repository settings (`.github/`)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tests or tooling only

## If the site changes

- [ ] Loading, empty and error states still look right (and the page works with no data at all)
- [ ] Checked on a phone-sized window and on a desktop one
- [ ] Works with the keyboard and makes sense to a screen reader (focus is never lost or hidden)
- [ ] Looks right in the light and the dark theme
- [ ] No new request leaves the browser, no cookie, no tracker, and the content security policy is no wider
- [ ] Size budgets still hold (JavaScript 100 KB, CSS 20 KB, gzipped)
- [ ] A new web feature has a row in the table of `docs/browser-support.md`
- [ ] New text is in `site/i18n/pt-BR.json`, in Brazilian Portuguese

## If the data or the rules change

- [ ] A broadcast or a rule changed with a link to an official source in the description
- [ ] No raw data from a provider and no team crest or logo was added
